answer: I would stop farms with touch pressure profile per identity, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. Faking 704 identities means 704 fresh proofs and 73216 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One echo of signal, one inlet of cost, one kernel of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
